Select IC50 activity rows for human Glycogen synthase kinase-3β. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Join docs on activities.doc_id to obtain PubMed ID or DOI. Left join compound_records on activities.record_id to retrieve compound_key. Filter by target name 'Glycogen synthase kinase-3β' and organism 'Homo sapiens', and by standard_type 'IC50'. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
